1.sahih_international: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
1.pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
1.yusuf_ali: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
1.shakir: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,
1.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), glorify the Name of your lord, the Most High,
1.mohsin_khan: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,
1.arberry: Magnify the Name of thy Lord the Most High

2.yusuf_ali: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
2.mohsin_khan: Who has created (everything), and then proportioned it;

3.yusuf_ali: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
3.shakir: And Who makes (things) according to a measure, then guides (them to their goal),
3.muhammad_sarwar: decreed their destinies, and provided them with guidance.
3.mohsin_khan: And Who has measured (preordainments for each and everything even to be blessed or wretched); then guided (i.e. showed mankind the right as well as wrong paths, and guided the animals to pasture);

4.sahih_international: And who brings out the pasture
4.yusuf_ali: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,
4.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has caused the grass to grow,
4.mohsin_khan: And Who brings out the pasturage,

5.pickthall: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
5.yusuf_ali: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
5.shakir: Then makes it dried up, dust-colored.
5.muhammad_sarwar: then caused it to wither away.
5.mohsin_khan: And then makes it dark stubble.
5.arberry: then made it a blackening wrack.

6.sahih_international: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
6.pickthall: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
6.yusuf_ali: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
6.shakir: We will make you recite so you shall not forget,
6.muhammad_sarwar: We shall teach you (the Quran) and you will not forget it
6.mohsin_khan: We shall make you to recite (the Quran), so you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) shall not forget (it),
6.arberry: We shall make thee recite, to forget not

7.sahih_international: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
7.pickthall: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
7.yusuf_ali: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
7.shakir: Except what Allah pleases, surely He knows the manifest, and what is hidden.
7.muhammad_sarwar: unless God wills it to be otherwise. He knows all that is made public and all that remains hidden.
7.mohsin_khan: Except what Allah, may will, He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.
7.arberry: save what God wills; surely He knows what is spoken aloud and what is hidden.

8.sahih_international: And We will ease you toward ease.
8.pickthall: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
8.yusuf_ali: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
8.shakir: And We will make your way smooth to a state of ease.
8.muhammad_sarwar: We shall make all your tasks easy.
8.mohsin_khan: And We shall make easy for you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) the easy way (i.e. the doing of righteous deeds).
8.arberry: We shall ease thee unto the Easing.

9.sahih_international: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
9.pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
9.yusuf_ali: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
9.shakir: Therefore do remind, surely reminding does profit.
9.muhammad_sarwar: Therefore, keep on preaching as long as it is of benefit.
9.mohsin_khan: Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them).
9.arberry: Therefore remind, if the Reminder profits,

10.sahih_international: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
10.yusuf_ali: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
10.muhammad_sarwar: Those who have fear of God will benefit
10.mohsin_khan: The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allah),
10.arberry: and he who fears shall remember,

11.sahih_international: But the wretched one will avoid it -
11.pickthall: But the most hapless will flout it,
11.yusuf_ali: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
11.shakir: And the most unfortunate one will avoid it,
11.muhammad_sarwar: but the reprobates will turn away
11.mohsin_khan: But it will be avoided by the wretched,
11.arberry: but the most wretched shall flout it,

12.sahih_international: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
12.pickthall: He who will be flung to the great Fire
12.yusuf_ali: Who will enter the Great Fire,
12.shakir: Who shall enter the great fire;
12.muhammad_sarwar: and suffer the heat of the great fire
12.mohsin_khan: Who will enter the great Fire and made to taste its burning,
12.arberry: even he who shall roast in the Great Fire,

13.pickthall: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
13.yusuf_ali: In which they will then neither die nor live.
13.shakir: Then therein he shall neither live nor die.
13.muhammad_sarwar: wherein they will neither live nor die.
13.mohsin_khan: Wherein he will neither die (to be in rest) nor live (a good living).
13.arberry: then he shall neither die therein, nor live.

14.sahih_international: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
14.yusuf_ali: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
14.shakir: He indeed shall be successful who purifies himself,
14.muhammad_sarwar: Lasting happiness will be for those who purify themselves,
14.mohsin_khan: Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islamic Monotheism) shall achieve success,
14.arberry: Prosperous is he who has cleansed himself,

15.sahih_international: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
15.pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
15.yusuf_ali: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
15.shakir: And magnifies the name of his Lord and prays.
15.muhammad_sarwar: remember the name of the Lord, and pray to Him.
15.mohsin_khan: And remembers (glorifies) the Name of his Lord (worships none but Allah), and prays (five compulsory prayers and Nawafil additional prayers).
15.arberry: and mentions the Name of his Lord, and prays.

16.sahih_international: But you prefer the worldly life,
16.pickthall: But ye prefer the life of the world
16.yusuf_ali: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
16.shakir: Nay! you prefer the life of this world,
16.muhammad_sarwar: However, (the disbelievers) prefer the worldly life
16.mohsin_khan: Nay, you prefer the life of this world;
16.arberry: Nay, but you prefer the present life;

17.sahih_international: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
17.pickthall: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
17.yusuf_ali: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
17.shakir: While the hereafter is better and more lasting.
17.muhammad_sarwar: even though the life hereafter will be better and will last forever.
17.mohsin_khan: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
17.arberry: and the world to come is better, and more enduring.

18.sahih_international: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
18.pickthall: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
18.yusuf_ali: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
18.shakir: Most surely this is in the earlier scriptures,
18.muhammad_sarwar: This is what is written in the ancient heavenly Books,
18.mohsin_khan: Verily! This is in the former Scriptures,
18.arberry: Surely this is in the ancient scrolls,

19.sahih_international: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
19.pickthall: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
19.yusuf_ali: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
19.shakir: The scriptures of Ibrahim and Musa.
19.muhammad_sarwar: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
19.mohsin_khan: The Scriptures of Ibrahim (Abraham) and Musa (Moses).
19.arberry: the scrolls of Abraham and Moses.
